Use invented data and disposable repositories. Do not attach private source files, checkpoint stores, credentials, or unreviewed reports. For sensitive security findings, follow the [security-report guidance](https://github.com/MendozaLab/Timber/blob/main/docs/SAFETY.md#security-reports) before posting details publicly.

## Environment

- Operating system:
- `timber --version`:
- `git --version`:

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest synthetic repository or folder setup and the exact command.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe both, including the error or refusal when relevant.

## Relevant state

Note staged/working differences, untracked or ignored files, recovery mappings, nested repositories, or other conditions needed to reproduce the result.
